findings.title: structure.py's dead-code screen treats a symbol as live if any same-named symbol is referenced, hiding 12 unreachable symbols
findings.claim: 12 top-level production symbols (grid_fee.is_valid_spec, presets.describe, and the unused _LOGGER in 10 modules) are unreachable from every Home Assistant root and are never called or read at runtime by production code, yet tests/structure.py reports dead_top_level_symbols=0 because its screen decides liveness by bare name across the whole package.
findings.mechanism: structure.py:module_references unions every Name load and attribute name across all modules, so dhw_schedule.is_valid_spec keeps grid_fee.is_valid_spec alive, comfort_band.describe keeps presets.describe alive, and any module's _LOGGER keeps every _LOGGER alive. grid_fee.is_valid_spec's only callers are tests, one of them config_flow_steps.py's #327 mutation arm. presets.describe's docstring says 'for display and for the sensor attributes', but no sensor calls it, and features.py:4423's check 'the derived values are presented as a starting point' pins a dict no user sees.

findings.title: cross_seam_edges and cut_* ratchet method names: a pure rename moves them by up to 7 and 22
findings.claim: 27 of the coordinator's 227 methods each lower the budgeted cross_seam_edges (140, zero headroom) when renamed alone with no code changed, by 1 to 7 per rename (5 with the top one left out); the largest single drop in sum(cut_*) is 22; 48 renames raise it.
findings.mechanism: structure.seam_metrics puts each method in a seam bucket by regex on its name (SEAM_REGEXES), so a rename re-buckets it and re-counts every self-call edge and attribute reference it touches. With every row at zero headroom, a PR can add up to 7 real cross-seam edges and pay for them by renaming _commanded_power.

findings.title: The wood-coil DHW edge of the two_tank_4way layout survives deletion under every driver in its closure
findings.claim: Disabling the 'if dhw_coil:' branch of topology.layout_edges (the wood_tank->dhw_tank edge of two_tank_4way) is killed by none of the Python scripts in topology.py's recorded closure (features.py plus 13 more) nor by card.mjs/card_drift.mjs; the only dhw_coil check (features.py:10513) passes dhw_coil=False.
findings.mechanism: layout_edges is the single composition the drawing and the editor's snap/match both use (its docstring). With the coil branch gone, a coil install's diagram loses its wood->DHW pipe and the editor's edge match changes, and no check sees it. In this year's train it is the only one of 6 items whose spot mutation survived.
